nodes.label: Frontend SPA Tech Stack (Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript Strict)
nodes.rationale: Uses Vite 6+, React 19, strict TypeScript, pnpm, TanStack Router v1 (SPA mode), TanStack Query v5, Zustand, react-hook-form + Zod, lucide-react, Tailwind CSS v4, and Biome for a fast, type-safe single-page messenger.

nodes.label: TanStack Router v1 SPA Mode
nodes.rationale: Chosen over TanStack Start because web messengers are SPAs by design, SSR conflicts with PWA offline caching, chat content does not need SEO, and SPA mode avoids meta-framework complexity.

nodes.label: Supabase Typed Client (src/lib/supabase.ts)
nodes.rationale: Wraps @supabase/supabase-js with auto-generated Database types from supabase gen types typescript so frontend queries remain strictly typed against the live Postgres schema.
